title: 23-BCV-001 — Window opening control devices (WOCD)

facts.text: The variance applies to residential occupancy buildings covered by Part 9.
A WOCD complying with ASTM F2090 is permitted as a means of addressing Sentences 9.8.8.1.(4) and 9.9.10.1.(1).
WOCD mechanisms are not permitted in adaptable or barrier-free dwelling units.
The source identifies the purpose as reducing risk of young children opening a window beyond 100 mm and falling.
